options.content:
CI/CD compute-minute usage scraped from the **gitlab-bridge** metrics endpoint (`:9092/metrics`) into VictoriaMetrics (Phase G, ka-0000002378; design `docs/research/cicd-minutes-metrics.md`).

**Two complementary series, each opt-in (both ship DISABLED by default):**
- **Job-duration** (`gardenio_cicd_minutes_total{provider="gitlab"}`) — compute minutes reconstructed from per-job durations. Lights up once `gitlabBridge.cicdMetrics.jobDurationEnabled` is on (runs on the existing bridge token).
- **First-party** (`gardenio_cicd_gitlab_minutes_*`) — GitLab's own billed usage/quota via GraphQL `ciMinutesUsage`. Needs `firstPartyEnabled` **and** the group-owner token (escalation ka-0000006982); until both land the used/quota/remaining/exceeded tiles have no series.

**Empty ≠ healthy.** Where a series is absent the stat tiles read a **neutral 'no data'** — never a green 'quota OK' or a red 'remaining critical'. Remaining/Quota-exceeded turn green/red **only** on a real sample, so an absent emitter cannot fabricate an all-clear or an alarm.

Use the **Provider** and **Project** template variables (top-left) to slice, or leave on _All_ for the total.

panels.title: Minutes/day by provider
panels.description: sum by (provider) increase(gardenio_cicd_minutes_total[1d]) — compute minutes billed per day, per provider.

panels.title: Top definitions/refs by minutes ($__range)
panels.description: topk(10, sum by (project, ref, provider) increase(gardenio_cicd_minutes_total[$__range])) — where the compute budget is going.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (project, ref, provider) (increase(gardenio_cicd_minutes_total{provider=~"$provider", project=~"$project"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Queued vs run time
panels.description: Queue wait (rate of gardenio_cicd_queued_seconds_total) vs run time (rate of gardenio_cicd_minutes_total × 60). A widening queue line signals runner starvation.

panels.title: Wasted CI — failed/canceled minutes ($__range)
panels.description: sum by (provider) increase(gardenio_cicd_minutes_total{status=~"failed|canceled"}[$__range]) — compute minutes spent on pipelines that did not succeed.

panels.title: Per-job duration p50 / p95 (GitLab)
panels.description: histogram_quantile over gardenio_cicd_job_duration_seconds — the slowest CI jobs. GitLab-only.

panels.title: Remaining (current month)
panels.description: gardenio_cicd_gitlab_remaining_current — compute minutes left before the quota is exhausted. Thresholds are illustrative (amber ≤ 500, red ≤ 100) — tune to your budget.

panels.description: gardenio_cicd_gitlab_exceeded_current — 1 (red) when current usage is at/above the total quota.

panels.title: First-party minutes used by project (current month)
panels.description: gardenio_cicd_gitlab_project_minutes_used_current — per-project share of first-party compute minutes.

panels.title: Scrape errors (rate)
panels.description: Per-series CI/CD-minutes API error rate. gardenio_cicd_scrape_errors_total is a label-gated CounterVec: a {provider} series exists only after that provider has failed once since the collector started, so a restart legitimately removes it (measured 2026-09-02: 17447 samples/30d, last one 57m before a bridge restart). The flat 0 is therefore EARNED off gardenio_cicd_scrape_duration_seconds, which the collector rewrites every scrape cycle — if the collector stops, the anchor stops with it and the panel falls through to noValue instead of painting a confident 0 (ka-0000006531). Sustained > 0 on gitlab-firstparty is expected until the group-owner token lands (ka-0000006982); sustained > 0 on gitlab means the collector cannot reach the pipelines API.

defaults.noValue: cicd collector not reporting — no gardenio_cicd_scrape_duration_seconds samples in window, so the scrape-error rate is UNKNOWN (not 0)

panels.title: Time since last successful scrape
panels.description: now − gardenio_cicd_last_success_timestamp_seconds. A rising line means a series has gone stale.

title: CI/CD — Compute Minutes
description: CI/CD compute minutes across providers: GitLab first-party quota burn (month-to-date vs quota), queue-vs-run time, per-job duration percentiles, and wasted minutes from failed/canceled pipelines. Open this when a pipeline feels slow or the monthly quota is in question.
